pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with moderate edge angularity. Dark brown pigmentation is concentrated centrally within the patches, with softer pixel gradients at the margins. Spatial area of patches is greatest on the upper flank, becoming more fragmented and smaller towards the lower abdomen.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-cream pathways. Junction nodes primarily consist of tri-directional intersections. Pixel thickness of corridors is variable, appearing widest at nodes and narrowing along the segments between patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette visible along the upper neck, though clarity is reduced by low image resolution. The mane presents as a continuous, slightly elevated ridge against the background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: Visible disruption in the continuity of the dorsal line at the junction of the neck and shoulder, coinciding with a transition into texturally anomalous tissue.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Large, expansive regions of dark, hyper-pigmented, and texturally disrupted tissue with a plaque-like or crusty appearance covering the dorsal ridge and extending significantly onto the upper flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Widespread, grey-brown crusty lesions consistent with dermatological disease covering the upper shoulder and lower cervical region.
